title: Imbued Diamonds
description: This is a simple Mod that adds Imbued Diamonds which can be used to craft tools and armor.
body:
# Imbued Diamonds

Imbued Diamonds is a lightweight mod that introduces a powerful new diamond upgrade path, complete with durable gear and magical potential.

## Features:

### Imbued Diamonds
A rare, reinforced diamond crafted from Hot Diamonds.

### Hot Diamonds
Smelt regular diamonds in a blast furnace to create these molten gems.

### Armor
Crafted from Imbued Diamonds. Same protection as Netherite, but significantly higher durability.

### Scepter
Begin your magical journey with this item. Combine a Blank Scepter with a Powered Diamond (crafted from an Imbued Diamond) to create the Powered Scepter.

### Tools  
Coming soon! Tools will match Netherite stats, but be far more durable.


## Compatibility:

Supports Minecraft 1.21 (More versions will come in the future)
